name: Delicious Thick-Cut Duelist's Burger
desc: A burger with a thick-cut steak as its main ingredient. Constructed to embody the philosophy of "defeating diners with deliciousness," the thick steak has a hearty texture, complemented by a variety of garnishes and toppings that bring out the flavor of the meat. It takes only one bite to be overwhelmed by the satisfaction of "defeat."

value.text: Increases all party members' ATK by 320 and CRIT Rate by 10% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
